description: Initial SCM/CM observation attribute catalog for log, trace, and audit JSONL outputs plus metric labels.

common.name: event.stream
common.description: Observation stream: log, trace, or audit.

common.name: event.outcome
common.description: Outcome: success, failure, unknown, or partial.

common.name: scm.app.name
common.description: Application name used in observation file path.

common.name: scm.app.profile
common.description: Application profile used in observation file path.

common.name: scm.app.label
common.description: Low-cardinality app label such as channel label.

target.name: scm.target.index
target.description: Target routing index in the pattern {stream}-{platform}-{channelCode}-{env}-{yyyy.MM.dd.HH}.

target.name: scm.target.legacy.enabled
target.description: Whether this JSONL event must be projected by scm-logging to a legacy table.

target.name: scm.target.legacy.table
target.description: Legacy projection target table. Mandatory when scm.target.legacy.enabled is true. Allowed values: ib.transaction, rb.message_log, cm.transaction_log, cm.user_action_log. ib.transaction, rb.message_log, and cm.transaction_log are produced from trace projection; cm.user_action_log is produced from audit CHANGE projection.

metric.name: app_name
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Application name.

metric.name: app_profile
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Runtime profile or environment label.

metric.name: app_label
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Low-cardinality deployment label.

metric.name: platform
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Source platform such as scm or cm.

metric.name: channel_code
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Channel code.

metric.name: gateway_name
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Gateway name.

metric.name: protocol
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Gateway protocol.

metric.name: request_name
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Low-cardinality request name.

metric.name: service_code
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Service code.

metric.name: operation_code
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Operation code.

metric.name: provider_code
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Provider code.

metric.name: provider_type
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Provider type.

metric.name: outcome
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Result label such as success or failure.

metric.name: error_code
metric.description: Prometheus/Micrometer label, not a JSONL field. Safe error or status code.

trace.name: parent.span.id
trace.description: Parent span identifier. Empty string is allowed for root spans.

trace.name: span.kind
trace.description: Span kind such as server, internal, or client.

audit.name: scm.audit.type
audit.description: Audit type. Allowed values: SERVICE or CHANGE.

transaction.name: scm.transaction.type
transaction.description: Transaction type or business transaction name.

gateway.name: scm.protocol
gateway.description: Protocol metadata such as http, soap, mq, jms, tcp, iso8583, or unknown.

gateway.name: scm.request.name
gateway.description: Low-cardinality gateway request name. For HTTP this should be a safe protocol request name, not a raw URL with dynamic IDs.

gateway.name: scm.route.id
gateway.description: Gateway route, template, or flow identifier when available.

operation.name: scm.operation.type
operation.description: Operation type such as PROVIDER, JAVA, or REST.

provider.name: scm.provider.code
provider.description: Provider code from scm.providers key or legacy provider name.

provider.name: scm.provider.scheme
provider.description: Provider Camel scheme such as scm-rest, scm-shetab, or scm-nab.

card.name: scm.card.no
card.description: Card number field when business rules allow writing it.

account.name: scm.account.no
account.description: Account number field when business rules allow writing it.

account.name: scm.destination
account.description: Destination card, account, IBAN, or business destination.

client.name: client.address
client.description: Protocol-neutral client, peer, queue manager, or source address.

http.name: http.method
http.description: HTTP method captured by the HTTP gateway adapter.

http.name: url.path
http.description: HTTP request path without query string.

http.name: http.route
http.description: Low-cardinality HTTP route template when safely available.

http.name: http.query.present
http.description: Whether an HTTP query string was present. Raw query string is forbidden.

auth.name: scm.auth.jwt.issuer
auth.description: JWT issuer derived from token claims.

auth.name: scm.auth.jwt.subject
auth.description: JWT subject derived from token claims.

auth.name: scm.auth.jwt.username
auth.description: JWT username derived from token claims.

auth.name: scm.auth.jwt.exp
auth.description: JWT expiration derived from token claims.

auth.name: scm.auth.jwt.hash
auth.description: Hash of JWT if token correlation is required. Raw token is forbidden.

error.name: error.message
error.description: Safe error message without sensitive data.

error.name: error.stack_trace
error.description: Stack trace when allowed by logging policy.
